κρύπτω.as:
κρύπτω,
[in LXX for חבא, טמן, סתר, צפן, etc.;]
to hide, conceal: c. acc., Mt 13:4425:18; seq. ἐν, Mt 25:25 (pass., Mt 13:44, Col 3:3); pass., Mt 5:14, He 11:23, I Ti 5:25, Re 2:17; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, v. M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν, Jo 8:59; seq. εἰς, Lk 13:21, Re 6:15; ἀπό (in cl. more freq. dupl. acc.), Re 6:16; pass., Jo 12:36, (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaph.: Mt 11:2513:35, Lk 11:52, WH, mg., 18:3419:42, Jo 19:38 (cf. ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).†

κρίσις.long: judging, judgment, decision, sentence; generally: divine judgment; accusation.
κρίσις.sd: decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law)
κρίσις.as:
κρίσις, -εως, ἡ
(< κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc.;]
1.a seperating, selection (Arist., al.)
2.a decision, judgment (cl.): Jo 8:16, I Ti 5:24, II Pe 2:11, Ju 9; κ. κρίνειν, Jo 7:24; in forensic sense, Ac 8:33(LXX) (v. Page, in l.); esp. of the Divine judgment, Jo 3:195:24, 27, 29, 3012:3116:8, 11, II Th 1:5, He 10:27, Ja 2:135:12, II Pe 2:4, Re 18:10; pl., Re 16:719:2; of the last judgment, Mt 10:1511:22, 2412:36, 41, 42, Lk 10:1411:31, 32, He 9:27, II Pe 2:93:7, I Jo 4:17, Ju 6, 15; ἡ κ. τῆς γεέννης, Mt 23:33.
3. By meton. (as in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Is 5:7, al.; דִּינָא, Da 7:10), of the standard of judgment, right, justice: Mt 12:18, 20 (LXX, Is 42:43) 23:23, Lk 11:42; of the tribunal (a local court), Mt 5:21, 22.†

κριτής.as:
κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁפַט;]
a judge: Mt 5:25, Lk 12:14, 5818:2; τ. ἀδικίας, Lk 18:6; c. gen. rei (obj.), Ac 18:15, Ja 4:11; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, Ja 2:4; of a Roman procurator, Ac 24:10; of God, He 12:23, Ja 4:12; Christ, Ac 10:42, II Ti 4:8, Ja 5:9; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, Mt 12:27, Lk 11:19; in the OT sense (Jg 2:16, Ru 1:1, al), of a ruler in Israel, Ac 13:20.†
SYN.: δικάστης, q.v.

κρίνω.long: (a) I judge, whether in a law-court or privately: sometimes with cognate nouns emphasizing the notion of the verb, (b) I decide, I think (it) good.
κρίνω.sd: by implication, to try, condemn, punish
κρίνω.kj: avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think
κρίνω.der: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially);
κρίνω.as:
κρίνω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for דּין, ריב, etc.;]
1.toseparate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: II Mac 13:15).
2.to approve, esteem: Ro 14:5.
3.to be of opinion, judge, think: Lk 7:43, I Co 11:13; seq. τοῦτο ὅτι, II Co 5:14; c. acc. et inf., Ac 16:15; c. acc. et pred., Ac 13:4626:8.
4.to decide, determine, decree: c. acc., Ac 16:4, Ro 14:13, I Co 7:37, II Co 2:1; c. inf. (Field, Notes, 167), Ac 20:1625:25, I Co 2:25:3, Tit 3:12 (cf. I Mac 11:33, Wi 8:9, al.); c. acc. et inf., Ac 21:2527:1.
5.to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., Jo 8:16, 26; seq. κατά, c. acc., Jo 7:248:15; κρίσιν κ., Jo 7:24; τ. δίκαιον, Lk 12:57 (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, Jo 18:31, Ac 23:3, al.; pass., Ro 3:4(LXX); of God's judgment, Jo 5:308:50, Ro 2:163:6, II Ti 4:1, I Pe 4:5, al.
6. = κατακρίνω, to condemn (cl.): Ac 13:27; of God's judgment, Jo 3:185:2212:47, 48, Ac 7:7, Ro 2:12, I Co 11:32, He 10:30(LXX), Ja 5:9, Re 19:2, al.
7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), to rule, govern (IV Ki 15:5, Ps 2:10, al.): Mt 19:28, Lk 22:30, I Co 6:3.
8.to bring to trial (cl.); mid., to go to law: c. dat. pers., Mt 5:40; seq. μετά, c. gen. pers. (of the opponent), ἐπί, c. gen. (of the judge), I Co 6:1, 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)).
SYN.: v.s. δικάστης.

κρυπτός.long: hidden, secret; as subst: the hidden (secret) things (parts), the inward nature (character).
κρυπτός.as:
κρυπτός, -ή, -όν
(κρύπτω), [in LXX for אטם, מִסְתָּר, etc.;]
hidden, secret: Mt 10:26, Mk 4:22, Lk 8:1712:2; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, I Pe 3:4; neut., ἐν τῷ κ., Mt 6:4, 6; ἐν κ., Jo 7:4, 1018:20; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, Ro 2:29; pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, I Co 4:5; τ. ἀνθρώπων, Ro 2:16; τ. καρδίας, I Co 14:25; τ. αἰσχύνης, II Co 4:2.†

κρυφαῖος.as:
κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(< κρύφα = κρυφῆ), [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, Je 23:24, al.;]
hidden, secret: ἐν τῷ κ., Mt 6:18.†

κρίνον.long: a lily growing wild, variously identified with the red anemone, the whole lily, the sword lily.
κρίνον.as:
κρίνον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן, שׁוֹשַׁנָּה;]
a lily: Mt 6:28, Lk 12:27.†

κρίμα.long: (a) a judgment, a verdict; sometimes implying an adverse verdict, a condemnation, (b) a case at law, a lawsuit.
κρίμα.sd: a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime"))
κρίμα.kj: avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment
κρίμα.as:
κρίμα (Bl., § 27, 2), -τος, τό
(< κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט;]
the issue of a judicial process, hence,
1.judgment, the decision passed on the faults of others: Mt 7:2; in forensic sense, c. gen. pun., Lk 24:20; esp. of the judgment of God, Ro 2:25:1611:33 (ICC, in l.), II Pe 2:3, Ju 4; κ. λαμβάι εσθαι, Mt 23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Mk 12:40, Lk 20:47, Ro 13:2, Ja 3:1; ἔχειν, I Ti 5:12; βαστάζειν, Ga 5:10; ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, I Co 11:29; εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, I Co 11:34; εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., Lk 23:40; c. gen. obj., Ro 3:8, I Ti 3:6, Re 17:1; of God's judgment through Christ, Jo 9:39; τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, I Pe 4:17; τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, Ac 24:25; κ. αἰώνιον, He 6:2; ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τ. κ. ὐμῶν, Re 18:20; of the right of judgment, Re 20:4.
2.a matter for judgment, a law-suit, a case: I Co 6:7.†

κρούω.long: I knock, beat a door with a stick, to gain admittance.
κρούω.as:
κρούω,
[in LXX: seq. ἐπί, Jg 19:22, Ca 5:2 (דִפק);] c, acc., τ. αὐλαίαν, Jth 14:14*;]
to strike, knock: at a door (κόπτειν, in Att.), Mt 7:7, 8, Lk 11:9, 1012:36, Ac 12:16, Re 3:20; c. acc., τ. θύραν, Lk 13:25, Ac 12:13.†

κράζω.sd: properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat)
κράζω.as:
κράζω,
[in LXX for זעק, צעק, קרא, etc.;]
in cl. chiefly poët.,
1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): Mk 5:59:2615:39 (Rec., R, mg.), Lk 9:39, al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. Ge 4:10), Ja 5:4.
2.to cry, callout with a loud voice: c. acc. rei, Ac 19:32; seq. orat. dir., Mk 10:48, Lk 18:39, al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Mk 5:7, Re 14:15, al.; λέγων, Mt 8:29, al.; of public teaching, Jo 1:15, Ro 9:27, al.; of importunate prayer (cf. Jb 35:12, Ps 3:5, al.), Ro 8:15, Ga 4:6; pf. with pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), Jo 1:15.
SYN.: v.s. βοάω.

κρημνός.as:
κρημνός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κρεμάννυμι), [in LXX: II Ch 25:12 (סֶלַע)*;]
a steep bank: Mt 8:32, Mk 5:13, Lk 8:33.†

κράσπεδον.sd: a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel
κράσπεδον.as:
κράσπεδον, -ου, τό,
[in LXX: Nu 15:38, 39 (צִיצִת) De 22:12, Za 8:23 (כָּנָף)*;]
1. in cl., an edge, border.
2. In LXX (v. supr.) and NT, a tassel or corner: Mt 9:2014:3623:5, Mk 6:56, Lk 8:44.†

κρατέω.long: I am strong, mighty, hence: I rule, am master, prevail; I obtain, take hold of; I hold, hold fast.
κρατέω.sd: to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively)
κρατέω.kj: hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by)
κρατέω.as:
κρατέω, -ῶ
(< κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חזק hi., also for אחז, etc.;]
1.to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: Es 1:1, I Es 4:38, Wi 14:19, al.).
2.to get possession of, obtain, take hold of (Hdt., Thuc., al.): c. gen. rei (M, Pr., 65), Ac 27:13; τ. χειρός, Mt 9:25, Mk 1:315:419:27, Lk 8:54; c. acc. rei, Mt 12:11; c. acc. pers., Mt 14:318:2821:4622:626:4, 48 ff., Mk 3:216:1712:1214:1, 44 ff., Ac 3:1124:6, Re 20:2 (cf. II Ki 6:6).
3.to hold, hold fast (Æsch., Polyb., al.): c. acc. rei, ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, Re 2:1. Metaph.: c. acc. pers., pass., Ac 2:24; c. acc. rei, Re 2:13, 253:11; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), Col 2:19; τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, Mk 7:3, 4, 89:10, II Th 2:15, Re 2:14, 15; c. gen. rei, He 4:146:18; of sins, to retain, Jo 20:23; of restraint, seq. ἵνα μή, Re 7:1; pass., seq. τοῦ μή, Lk 24:16.†

κραυγάζω.as:
κραυγάζω (< κραυγή),
[in LXX: II Es 3:13 (רוּעַ hi.)*;] = κράζω,
1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc.
2. Of men, to cry out, shout: Mt 12:19, Jo 12:1319:15, Ac 22:23; seq. λέγων, Jo 18:4019:6, 12; καὶ λέγων, Lk 4:41 (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Jo 11:43 (cf. Abbott, JV, 269 f.).†

κρεμάννυμι.long: I hang, hang up, suspend; mid: I am hanging, hang.
κρεμάννυμι.der: a prolonged form of a primary verb;
κρεμάννυμι.as:
κρεμάννυμι
(also κρεμαννύω, κρεμάω; the pres. is not found in NT), [in LXX (where also κρεμάζω, Jb 26:7) chiefly for תּלה;]
trans., to hang, suspend: c. acc. pers., seq. ἐπὶ ξύλου, Ac 5:3010:39; pass., Lk 23:39; seq. περί, Mt 18:6. Mid., κρέμαμαι, intrans., to hang: seq. ἐκ, Ac 28:4; ἐπὶ ξύλου, Ga 3:13(LXX); metaph., seq. ἐν, Mt 22:40.†

κραυγή.long: (a) a shout, cry, clamor, (b) outcry, clamoring against another.
κραυγή.sd: an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief)
κραυγή.as:
κραυγή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX for צְעָקָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc.;]
crying, outcry, clamour: Mt 25:6, Lk 1:42, Ac 23:9, Eph 4:31, He 5:7, Re 21:4.†

κρανίον.der: diminutive of a derivative of the base of G2768 (κέρας);
κρανίον.as:
κρανίον, -ου, τό
(< κάρα, the head), [in LXX: Jg 9:53, IV Ki 9:35 (גֻּלְגֹּלֶת)*;]
a skull: Mt 27:33, Mk 15:22, Lk 23:33, Jo 19:17.†

κράβαττος.long: a bed, mattress, mat of a poor man.
κράβαττος.as:
**† κράβαττος (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ
(a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), [in Aq.: Am 3:12*;]
a camp bed, pallet: Mk 2:4, 9, 11, 126:55, Jo 5:8-11, Ac 5:159:33 (v. Swete, Mk., 2:4, and cf. κλίνη).†

κράτιστος.long: most excellent, an official epithet, used in addressing a Roman of high rank, and in the second century one of equestrian (as distinguished from senatorial) rank.
κράτιστος.der: superlative of a derivative of G2904 (κράτος);
κράτιστος.as:
κράτιστος, -η, -ον,
superl. of κρατύς (Hom.),
1.strongest, mightiest (Hom.).
2.noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), most excellent (Pind., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), Lk 1:3, Ac 23:2624:326:25.†

κράτος.long: dominion, strength, power; a mighty deed.
κράτος.as:
κράτος, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX chiefly for עֹז, Jb 12:16, Ps 89 (90):11 al.;]
1.strength, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength.
2.power, might: He 2:14; τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, Eph 1:196:10 (Is 40:26, Da TH 4:27); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, Col 1:11; κατὰ κράτος, mightily, Ac 19:20; a mighty deed, an act of power, Lk 1:51; in doxologies, I Ti 6:16, I Pe 4:115:11, Ju 25, Re 1:65:13.†

κραταιόομαι.long: I strengthen, confirm; pass: I grow strong, become strong.
κραταιόομαι.sd: to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor
κραταιόομαι.as:
† κραταιόω, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; < κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חזק;]
to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: Lk 2:40, I Co 16:13; πνεύματι, Lk 1:80; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, Eph 3:16.†

κρύπτη.long: a cellar, vault, hidden place, crypt.
κρύπτη.as:
*† κρύπτη (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ,
a crypt, cellar: Lk 11:33.†

κραιπάλη.sd: properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut)
κραιπάλη.der: probably from the same as G726 (ἁρπάζω);
κραιπάλη.as:
* κραιπάλη
(κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שׁכר, Is 24:2029:9),
drunken nausea (EV, surfeiting): Lk 21:34.†
SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (v. Tr., Syn., § lxi).

κρίθινος.as:
κρίθινος, -η, -ον
(< κριθή), [in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה;]
of barley: Jo 6:9, 13.

Κρής.long: a Cretan, an inhabitant of Crete.
Κρής.sd: a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete
Κρής.as:
Κρής, ὁ, pl., Κρῆτες,
a Cretan: Ac 2:11, Tit 1:12.†

Κρίσπος.long: Crispus, ruler of the synagogue at Corinth, converted and baptized by Paul.

Κρήτη.sd: Crete, an island in the Mediterranean
Κρήτη.as:
Κρήτη, -ης, ἡ,
Crete: Ac 27:7, 12, 13, 31, Tit 1:5.†

κρέας.long: flesh; plur: pieces of flesh, kinds of flesh.
κρέας.as:
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα,
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.);]
flesh, meat: Ro 14:21, I Co 8:13.†

κριτήριον.long: criterion; a law-court; a law-case before an arbiter; a cause, controversy.
κριτήριον.sd: a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal
κριτήριον.der: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2923 (κριτής);
κριτήριον.as:
κριτήριον, -ου, τό
(< κριτής), [in LXX: III Ki 7:7 (מִשְׁפָּט), Da LXX TH 7:10, TH:26, (דִּין), Su 49, Ex 21:6, Jg 5:10*;]
1.a means of judging, test, criterion.
2.a tribunal: I Co 6:2, 4, Ja 2:6.†

κρείττων.der: comparative of a derivative of G2904 (κράτος);

κρυφῇ.as:
κρυφῇ
(prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dat.; cf. εἰκῆ),
adv.,
[in LXX chiefly for סתר;]
secretly, in secret: Eph 5:12.†

Κρήσκης.long: Crescens, a Christian, coadjutor of Paul.

κριτικός.long: critical, able to judge or discern.
κριτικός.as:
* κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(< κρίνω),
critical, able to discern or judge: c. gen. obj., He 4:12.†

κραταιός.as:
κραταιός, -ά, -όν
(< κράτος), (in cl. poët. form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for חָזָק and cognates;]
strong, mighty: I Pe 5:6.†

κρύσταλλος.as:
κρύσταλλος, -ου, ὁ
(< κρύος, frost), [in LXX: Jb 38:29, Ps 147:6, (17), Ez 1:22 (קֶרַח), etc.;]
crystal: Re 4:622:1.†

κριθή.as:
κριθή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה;]
barley: pl. (as usually in cl.), Re 6:6.†

κρυσταλλίζω.long: I am clear as crystal, brilliant like crystal.
κρυσταλλίζω.as:
*† κρυσταλλίζω
(< κρύσταλλος),
to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: Re 21:11 (ἅπ. λεγ.).†
